_header.what: Visible reflectance spectra, 380 to 780 nm every 10 nm (fractions), resampled linearly from the library files; spectra that start at 400 or 420 nm hold their first value below it.
_header.source: ECOSTRESS Spectral Library 1.0: S. K. Meerdink, S. J. Hook, D. A. Roberts and E. A. Abbott, "The ECOSTRESS spectral library version 1.0", Remote Sensing of Environment 230, 111196 (2019), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2019.05.015, https://speclib.jpl.nasa.gov; its ASTER part: A. M. Baldridge, S. J. Hook, C. I. Grove and G. Rivera, "The ASTER spectral library version 2.0", Remote Sensing of Environment 113, 711 (2009), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2008.11.007.
_header.licence: NASA JPL data, free to use with the citations above. Retrieved 2026-11-28.
